QuoteRequest.title: QuoteRequest
QuoteRequest.description: Customer battery price quote request and installation enquiry for Nath Battery Latur.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the customer.

vehicleOrSystem.description: Vehicle model or home inverter setup details.

phoneNumber.description: Customer phone number for quote/WhatsApp follow-up.

exchangeOldBattery.description: Whether customer wants old battery buyback discount.

doorstepService.description: Whether customer requests doorstep testing and installation in Latur.

locationArea.description: Locality in Latur (e.g., Kaneri Chowk, Patel Nagar, MIDC).

estimatedPriceInr.description: Estimated battery price in INR after optional buyback.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when quote was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when quote was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ServiceBooking.title: ServiceBooking
ServiceBooking.description: Customer booking for free battery health check, alternator test, or doorstep jumpstart in Latur.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the customer.

vehicleDetails.description: Vehicle or inverter model and location notes.

preferredSlot.description: Preferred daily slot between 9:30 AM and 8:00 PM.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when booking was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when booking was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/quote_requests/{quoteId}.description: Per-user battery price quote requests for Nath Battery.
